# Groundquote

> Groundquote is a free, open-source document question-answering application
> that returns citation-backed answers or safely says when the source is
> insufficient.

## Primary links

- [Use Groundquote](https://groundquote.vercel.app/)
- [How Groundquote works](https://groundquote.vercel.app/#how-it-works)
- [Learn RAG in 60 seconds](https://groundquote.vercel.app/#learn-rag)
- [Plain-English RAG guide](https://groundquote.vercel.app/learn/rag)
- [Privacy](https://groundquote.vercel.app/privacy)
- [Source code](https://github.com/eatusc-personal/groundquote)
- [Full project context](https://groundquote.vercel.app/llms-full.txt)

## Key capabilities

- Single-document retrieval-augmented question answering
- Visible source passages and validated inline citation IDs
- Safe no-answer behavior when evidence is insufficient
- Hybrid BM25 and semantic retrieval when an OpenAI key is configured
- Deterministic evidence-only fallback when generation is unavailable
- Text, Markdown, CSV, and JSON input

Groundquote is not a persistent knowledge base and should not be treated as
legal, medical, or financial advice.
